title: Mixing: Wings live in Newcastle | 1974
content:
EMI Studios, London
Producer: Ian Horne

The first of three stereo mixing sessions for a Wings concert at City Hall in Newcastle upon Tyne, England, took place on 2 April 1974.

The concert had taken place on 10 July 1973. The mixes were not intended for a live album; Paul McCartney was considering including live recordings in a compilation of non-album songs and outtakes.

The three mixing sessions were overseen by Ian Horne, a roadie and sound engineer for Wings.
